node.title: KoalaBear source-pencil rank and transverse compiler
node.closure: exact rank compiler plus primitive-subdegree same-fiber exclusion
node.statement: For each supplied KoalaBear endpoint record, the six live decomposition profiles have 32,099 canonical source templates with exact source-rank and active-syndrome gates; this is per record, not a global census. After strict right-factor routing, no terminal inner degree 2,3,4,6,10,12 has primitive monodromy subdegree four, so the actual bidegree-(4,4) component is not same-fiber. Every survivor is one of 26 transverse types satisfying delta*r=4m, delta<=m^2, r<=60/m-1. Source-only controls survive at degrees two and three; no transverse deletion, owner, charge, u2 close, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
